title: Nagi Notes (bc30)
synopsis:
Bucolic Nagi is home to scenic landscapes, a unique art museum and a Self-Defense Force base. One day, Yuri travels to Nagi to model for her friend Yoriko, a wood carving artist. As wood shavings fall to the ground, the two gradually open up about past trauma. Meanwhile, two teenage boys grapple with anxiety and restlessness of growth, ultimately taking a bold step forward. Their actions might seem rash and reckless, but who doesn't yearn for that fearless impulse of youth? As the boys bravely embrace the future, the two women also gradually find their way forward.

 

Competition, Cannes Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
奈義町風光宜人，有別緻的美術館，亦有自衛隊基地。一天，友梨前往奈義，為木雕藝術家好友寄子擔任模特兒。隨着木屑一片片掉落，兩人漸漸聊起過往的傷痕。與此同時，兩名少年亦經歷着青春期的不安與躁動，作出大膽的一步。男孩的行為或顯年少輕狂，但誰又不想念那股青澀而無所畏懼的衝動？在少年勇敢邁向未來之時，友梨和寄子亦漸漸找到前進的方向。籌備九年而成，深田晃司新作再戰康城，描繪出平淡九日裡的不平凡勇氣。松隆子、石橋靜河絲絲入微的演繹，教人觀影後餘韻無窮。

 

康城影展 主競賽單元

cast: Takako Matsu, Shizuka Ishibashi, Kenichi Matsuyama
